_intro_AI_ASSISTANT: This file is a STARTER. Tune every value below for the host project. See `_help` keys inline for guidance. Common edits: switch `tests.command` to whatever the project uses (`npm test`, `pnpm test`, `cargo test`, `pytest -q`...), point `fitness.testPath` at the repo's actual architecture-fitness test, narrow `typecheck.patterns` to the right tsconfig, fill `tests.knownFlakes` from .anvil/known-flakes.txt or post-mortems.
_comment: Drop this at .anvil/pre-merge-gate.config.json in your repo. /pre-merge-gate reads it.
_help_rebaseAgainst: Branch the gate rebases against. Usually `origin/main`. Override per-repo if your default branch is `master`, `develop`, etc.

typecheck._help: If only part of the repo has TS coverage, narrow `patterns` to that subtree (e.g. `["v3/tsconfig.json"]`). Set `enabled: false` if the project has no TypeScript.

tests._help_command: Replace with whatever runs the project's tests. Examples: `npm test`, `pnpm vitest run`, `cargo test`, `pytest -q`, `bun test`.
tests._baseline_modes: auto = read from main HEAD; <number> = absolute count; +N = baseline + N
tests._help_knownFlakes: Either list flake patterns inline or rely on .anvil/known-flakes.txt — the gate reads both.

fitness._help: Path to the project's architecture-fitness test (the one that pins call-site counts, layer boundaries, etc). If the project doesn't have one, set `enabled: false` — but consider adding one. Set `_alternativeTestPath` if there are two (e.g. v2 + v3 trees).

ci._comment: Verify GH PR checks before merging. Set false to skip (e.g. local-only repo).
ci._help_blockingChecks: Names of GH checks that must pass before merge. Examples: ['test', 'secrets', 'lint', 'codeql']. Pull names from a recent green PR via `gh pr checks <PR>`.
ci._help_ignorablePending: GH checks that may stay pending without blocking merge — typically downstream deploys.
